key.name: show-home
key.description: Minimises every other window and focuses the launcher.

key.name: tv-power
key.summary: Switch the television off or on
key.description: Asks the launcher to toggle the TV over the network. XF86Launch1 is what a TV remote's Power button reports once the HDLounge keymap is installed.

key.name: kiosk-mode
key.description: Hide the top panel and suppress the Activities overview so the launcher is the only desktop UI. Set to false to get stock GNOME chrome back for debugging.

key.name: force-fullscreen
key.description: Fullscreen windows belonging to apps launched from the drawer.
